Package com.nexuslink.core.event

Class EventBus

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.core.event.EventBus
public final class EventBus extends Object
Typed, async-capable pub/sub event bus. Listeners are held weakly — no need to unsubscribe if the subscriber is GC'd. Post on any thread; listeners fire on the specified executor (defaults to caller's thread).
